quick: Fixed molar ratio with tegafur; dose is expressed as tegafur
summary: Gimeracil is a dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase (DPD) inhibitor that keeps 5-FU levels up when given with tegafur and oteracil in S-1. It has no anticancer effect of its own; see Tegafur for dosing and safety.
indications: Only as a component of tegafur/gimeracil/oteracil (S-1)

dosage.d: Fixed molar ratio with tegafur; dose is expressed as tegafur

admin: Use only as the finished product directs
moa: Reversible DPD inhibition reduces fluorouracil catabolism.
renal: Renally cleared: accumulates in renal impairment, increasing 5-FU exposure
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
